entries.title: Susan Smith denied parole again 32 years after drowning her two sons
entries.snippet: At a hearing on the possibility of parole, Smith said she wished she could change the past, and her two children "did not deserve to die".

entries.snippet: A federal judge has twice delayed construction of Trump's arch. Another is keeping East Potomac Park open. The proposed golf course redesign got mixed feedback from a federal arts panel on Thursday.

entries.title: The 'Magic Six': How to strengthen your marriage in midlife
entries.snippet: How do we maintain healthy romantic relationships as we age? Allison Aubrey and Scott Detrow talk about about the science of healthy, later-in-life relationships.

entries.title: 'Bigger than Barack Obama's election': Scholars reflect on Mississippi Senate race
entries.snippet: Scott Colom is now this Southern state's first Black U.S. senator in nearly 150 years. Scholars and Mississippi natives Eddie Glaude and Kiese Laymon discuss the historic significance of his victory.

entries.title: The midterms were the largest win for either party in 50 years
entries.snippet: Some 56% of people cast votes for Democrats in House races, compared to 42% who voted Republican. That 14-point spread is the widest win for either party in 50 years, since after Watergate.

entries.title: The U.N.'s top court rules Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya
entries.snippet: The International Court of Justice found that Myanmar security forces "acted with genocidal intent" against the Rohingya during military operations in the northern Rakhine state in 2017.

entries.title: World Toilet Day is a funny idea with a serious goal: A world awash in toilets
entries.snippet: Yahoo for the loo! November 19 marks the 25th anniversary of World Toilet Day. The theme this year: "Sanitation and Gender Equality: Safe Toilets, Equal Futures."

entries.title: Anthropic raises more than $100B in IPO. And, Dems nominate Jeffries for House speaker
entries.snippet: Despite growing concern over a possible AI bubble, Anthropic had a record-breaking initial public offering. And, Hakeem Jeffries could become the first Black Speaker of the House.

entries.snippet: Rep. Gregory Meeks raises concerns about U.S. alliances after Trump's summit with Xi and Putin. He also discusses Chinese espionage amid the Nvidia scandal.

entries.title: Muslims will outnumber Christians worldwide by 2035, report says
entries.snippet: By 2070, the Democratic Republic of the Congo will surpass the United States as the country with the largest total number of Christians.

entries.title: Do you need a measles booster shot now that the U.S. has lost its elimination status?
entries.snippet: The U.S., Mexico and Bolivia lost their measles-free status this week after stubborn outbreaks erased decades of progress.

entries.snippet: High diesel prices have made it more expensive for farmers to process and transport Thanksgiving staples like milk, dinner rolls, potatoes and cranberries, the Farm Bureau said.

entries.title: 3 takeaways from Trump, Xi and Putin's historic summit
entries.snippet: The meeting between U.S. President Donald Trump, China's Xi Jinping and Russia's Vladimir Putin on Thursday was the first-ever sit-down for the leaders of the three countries.

entries.title: Prosecutor declines to charge Wisconsin officer who fatally shot Black man in Madison
entries.snippet: The Wisconsin police officer who shot and killed a 38-year-old Black man in Madison in July will not face criminal charges, a prosecutor announced Thursday, sparking calls for justice from the victim's family members and community advocates.

entries.title: Judge issues 14-day extension of order blocking Trump's triumphal arch construction
entries.snippet: A federal judge on Wednesday temporarily extended an order blocking the Trump administration from breaking ground on a towering memorial arch in the nation's capital.

entries.title: Ella Langley sweeps the 2026 CMA Awards and wins entertainer of the year
entries.snippet: It didn't take a crystal ball to see: The 2026 Country Music Association Awards were always going to be all about Ella Langley.

entries.title: Cincinnati Zoo says Fiona the hippo has died, more than a week after ingesting a hat
entries.snippet: "It is with extreme sadness that we share with you the devastating news that Fiona did not make it after multiple attempts from our amazing vets and keeper team to help her through what ended up being a medical emergency," the zoo said in a statement.

entries.title: Fact-checking Mullin's House hearing on FAA ground stop, outages and dirty bombs
entries.snippet: Following a week of flight delays, website outages and the possibility of an Iranian dirty bomb attack, House lawmakers grilled top administration officials, including Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin, about threats to the United States.

entries.title: Iowans brace for lead dust cloud as Army plans to detonate 5 tons of bomb-making chemicals
entries.snippet: Plans by the U.S. Army to detonate about 5 tons of bomb-making chemicals that have become unusable and might explode if moved have residents in southeast Iowa worried that a cloud of lead dust could cause environmental contamination and health problems.

entries.title: Mississippi saw a spike in 'inactive' voters for the midterms. Democratic lawmakers want answers
entries.snippet: Lawmakers want an investigation and legislation to ensure that eligible voters are not mistakenly moved to inactive status, especially as the party tries to maintain its political momentum going into next year's race for governor.

entries.title: NASA's Voyager 1 calls Earth from more than 16 billion miles, or one light-day, away
entries.snippet: It marked another day in the history books for Voyager 1, which launched in 1977.

entries.snippet: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

entries.title: New Ukraine talks including Europe to be held 'soon' — Merz
entries.snippet: Germany's Chancellor Friedrich Merz says European leaders could take part in fresh Ukraine talks on "neutral ground." The UK and EU countries have urged a seat at the table in meetings between the US, Russia and Ukraine.

entries.title: 'Humanitarian mission' for Kostiantynivka: Is it a trap?
entries.snippet: Russian President Putin has proposed an evacuation of the Ukrainian city of Kostiantynivka, like the recent operation in Oleshky. Experts warn this could serve military, not humanitarian, aims. What should Kyiv do?

entries.title: Uganda minister at COP31: 'We need a just transition'
entries.snippet: Funding from wealthy countries to help deal with the impacts of climate change hasn't materialized, says Uganda's environment minister. The East African country is hoping oil and carbon credits will help boost finances.

entries.title: Germany news: Pistorius visits Auschwitz memorial in Poland trip
entries.snippet: Germany's defense minister's first stop in Poland was the memorial site of the former Nazi extermination camp Auschwitz-Birkenau. Follow DW for more.

entries.title: Iraq's risky standoff: The state vs. Iran-allied militias
entries.snippet: This week, Iraqi security forces surrounded an area run by the Kataib Hezbollah militia. Onlookers describe it as the most dangerous confrontation between the Iraqi state and Iran-allied militias in decades.

entries.title: European leaders present united front in push for peace in Ukraine
entries.snippet: Talks in Berlin end with reaffirmed support for Kyiv and a concerted push for European representation at future peace talks to end Russia's invasion of Ukraine.

entries.title: Xi Jinping, Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin have held trilateral talks ― but what did they achieve?
entries.snippet: The presidents of China, the US and Russia have held an unprecedented summit. While Trump said the three leaders were "making history," Xi described the talks as "fruitful" and Putin called them "open and candid."

entries.title: No mention of fossil fuels in latest COP31 draft deal
entries.snippet: One of the most fraught debates at the UN climate talks in Turkey has revolved around the future of coal, oil and gas. Now, all mention of fossil fuels has been removed from the summit's new draft agreement.

entries.title: Anthropic trading tests investors' appetite for AI
entries.snippet: Anthropic was valued at $2 trillion after shares started trading on the Nasdaq following a record $81 billion IPO. Its performance will put investor confidence in AI to the test.

entries.title: Alexander Zverev faces fresh lawsuit from ex-girlfriend
entries.snippet: World No. 1 tennis player Alexander Zverev is facing a new lawsuit related to a domestic abuse trial. The lawyer for his ex-girlfriend, Brenda Patea, told DW what the allegations are against the German player.

entries.title: EU Commission confirms it was targeted in cyberattack using AI tools
entries.snippet: The European Commission was targeted by an "AI-generated cybercampaign," a spokesperson has said. This is the first time the bloc has publicly reported an AI-based cyberattack.

entries.title: Wadephul: 'Coalition of the Willing' talks in Berlin send strong signal to Moscow
entries.snippet: German Foreign Minister Wadephul has said the Coalition of the Willing meeting in Berlin sends a clear message to Moscow to take peace talks seriously. He also warned Ukraine should be prepared for peace talks to fail.

entries.title: Pakistan minister to visit India, but no breakthrough expected
entries.snippet: A Pakistani minister's visit to India for a Shanghai Cooperation Organization forum marks a rare high-level contact between the two archrivals, but analysts say it does not signal a resumption of bilateral engagement.

entries.title: APEC summit: Trump, Xi, Putin talks end with 'peace declaration'
entries.snippet: The three world leaders discussed the Russian invasion of Ukraine as well as nuclear arms controls. Following the trilateral talks, President Trump reportedly headed to the airport.

entries.title: Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya, top UN court rules
entries.snippet: The International Court of Justice has upheld large parts of a genocide case against Myanmar linked to the 2017 conflict with its Rohingya minority. It called for it to pay reparations and let refugees return safely.

entries.title: Denmark ratifies security deal with US and Greenland
entries.snippet: The deal provides the US with expanded military access, on top of what it already had based on a previous agreement. It comes after threats by US President Trump to take Greenland with force.

entries.title: South Korea's top court overturns jail term for former PM Han
entries.snippet: Former Prime Minister Han Duck-so was convicted of helping legitimize the 2024 martial law declaration. The case will now return to a lower court.

entries.title: Iran balances ties with China and Russia as Trump ramps up pressure
entries.snippet: As Donald Trump seeks to tighten economic pressure on Iran, China remains its biggest oil customer and Russia a key partner. But both powers are balancing support for Tehran against broader interests with Washington.

entries.title: India: Nearly 50,000 evacuated as Cyclone Akvan nears the coast
entries.snippet: Cyclone Akvan, the third severe storm to hit India's east coast in a month, is expected to make landfall on November 20. Meanwhile, PM Modi led a meeting of his Council of Ministers.
